tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere; the dark value is flok's terminal ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the monitor drawer, the status page card, a hovered or selected list row.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: text inputs, the ping URL, code samples.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and around panels. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, chips). At least 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and surface-sunk (15:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: slugs, timestamps, hints, taglines. 5:1 or better on ground, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive colour: links, the primary button fill, a pressed chip, the focus ring. Text in accent reads at 4.5:1+ on ground, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a pressed filter chip and of the maintenance banner; text on it is accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Logo ink only: the vink mark and wordmark brackets. Cyan on dark grounds, W4J teal on light.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: W4J teal, the tie to w4jnl: favicon tile, avatar, app icon. White on it is 3.5:1, fine for the mark, never for body text.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: State up: glyph, word and uptime cells. As text 5:1+ on ground, surface and up-soft.

tokens.name: up-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an up pill and the all-clear banner.

tokens.name: late
tokens.usage: State late: a heartbeat past its deadline but inside grace, or a pull check failing but not yet confirmed. As text 4.7:1+ on ground, surface and late-soft.

tokens.name: late-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a late pill and a degraded banner.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: State down and destructive actions. As text 4.5:1+ on ground, surface and down-soft.

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a down pill and an outage banner.

tokens.name: on-down
tokens.usage: Text on a down fill: the armed delete button, the down favicon tile.

tokens.name: paused
tokens.usage: State paused: the pause glyph and word.

tokens.name: new
tokens.usage: State new: no observation yet; drawn as a dashed ring.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, as in flok: the wordmark, the CLI and every piece of brand imagery.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark. Lockups use the outlined SVGs; this style is for places that set it live.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Headlines on the README hero, social card and status page title.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The web UI sets words in the system face, so it is fast, local and offline-safe.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per page: the page or drawer title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside the drawer and settings tabs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The monitor goes late 5 minutes after the expected time.
styles.usage: All running text, monitor names in lists, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, chip labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Anything a person might copy, compare or grep is mono with tabular figures.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Slugs, URLs, durations, latencies, relative and absolute times, counts.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: The one datum a row is about, e.g. a failing latency.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Crontab lines, YAML, request bodies, ping payloads.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one big number: uptime in the drawer and on the status page.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to word inside a badge; cell gap in the uptime bar is half this.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List row side padding; panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Drawer and panel padding; between drawer sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Status page top padding; empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: State pills, tags, uptime cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, the ping URL field.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Drawer, panels, banners, status page card.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: App icon and avatar tiles (W4J's rounded square); favicon uses 7 of 32.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The drawer and an open top-bar menu. Nothing else in vink casts a shadow.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, the ping URL field.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Height of filter chips.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Height of a monitor list row.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Width of the monitor drawer on desktop; full width under 640px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the monitor list column.

tokens.name: mark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest size the mark may be drawn; below it use the favicon tile.
